title: Chrome browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each profile is a separate browsing identity. Profile names and the accounts signed into Chrome show who used this computer and how many separated identities they kept.
source: Chromium docs, user data directory and per-profile folders; Chrome on Linux keeps its user data root in ~/.config/google-chrome: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences file that every profile has, so sibling non-profile folders are skipped. google-chrome is the stable package; beta and dev use google-chrome-beta and google-chrome-unstable. The Local State file with the profile list sits next to the profile folders.
